caption:
Momo loves her after-work dance fitness class, but lately her knee twinges every time she spins.

Spinning on a planted foot can twist the knee. Lifting your heel slightly and letting your feet turn with you may help share that load.

Hybi's tip: warm up for five minutes, land with softly bent knees, pivot on the ball of your foot, and choose the low-impact option on harder days.

Swelling, a knee that catches or gives way, or no change after two weeks are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
